risks.title: Store In-App Purchase Verification & Receipt Validation
risks.description: Apple App Store Server Notifications and Google Play Real-Time Developer Notifications (RTDN) require a secure backend webhook listener with cryptographic signature verification to prevent fraudulent coin grants.
risks.mitigation: Implement server-side receipt validation via App Store Server API and Google Play Developer API with idempotent transaction tokens.
risks.client_question: Do you have existing Apple Developer Organization and Google Play Console developer accounts enrolled with banking details set up?

risks.title: Real-time Push Notification Fan-Out & Rate Limits
risks.description: Immediate push notifications on viral pet posts can flood APNs/FCM thresholds, resulting in throttling or server CPU spikes.
risks.mitigation: Use an asynchronous queue (e.g., Redis Celery/BullMQ) to batch notification payloads and debounce repeated activity bursts.
risks.client_question: What is the expected initial user count and daily active sessions for the launch marketing campaign?

risks.title: Multi-Platform Camera & Sticker Performance
risks.description: Custom image rendering and stickers on low-end Android devices can lead to frame drops during viewfinder capture.
risks.mitigation: Pre-rasterize SVG stickers and offload final photo compositing to native image rendering threads.
risks.client_question: Are sticker assets provided as vector SVGs or high-resolution PNG sprite sheets?

scope_creep_warnings.vague_quote: completely bug-free and scale infinitely without any slowdown
scope_creep_warnings.why_dangerous: Zero-bug guarantees and 'infinite scaling' are mathematically impossible non-functional assertions that invite open-ended unpaid optimization cycles.
scope_creep_warnings.suggested_sow_clause: System architecture is benchmarked and sized to support up to 5,000 concurrent active users and a 99.5% uptime SLA. Bug fixes are guaranteed within a 30-day post-launch warranty window for severity 1 and 2 issues.

scope_creep_warnings.vague_quote: launch in the App Store within 4 weeks
scope_creep_warnings.why_dangerous: Apple App Review and Google Play closed testing tracks have uncontrollable review timelines (typically 3 to 7 business days) outside the developer's control.
scope_creep_warnings.suggested_sow_clause: Milestone delivery dates reflect code completion and TestFlight submission. Consultant is not liable for delays arising from third-party app store review queues or credential verification holds.

assumptions: Client provides Apple Developer ($99/yr) and Google Play ($25) active developer credentials.
Graphic assets, brand colors, and pet sticker artwork will be supplied in Figma format prior to Sprint 2.

brief_text:
# Project Brief: "PawSnap" - Instagram for Pets MVP

## Overview
We are looking for a skilled freelance mobile engineer to build the MVP of PawSnap, a photo-sharing mobile application dedicated exclusively to pets and pet parents.

## Key Functional Requirements
1. User Authentication: Users should be able to sign up and login with Apple ID and Google OAuth. We also need password reset via email.
2. Pet Profiles: Users can create up to 5 pet profiles with breed, age, and bio.
3. Feed & Realtime Activity: A vertical scrolling photo feed of followed pets with realtime like counters and instant push notifications when someone comments.
4. Photo Filters & Camera: Direct camera capture with custom animal stickers and photo cropping.
5. In-App Purchases: Pet parents should be able to buy 'Treat packs' (virtual currency) using Apple App Store In-App Purchases and Google Play Billing to reward content creators.
6. Moderation & Flagging: Basic image reporting for inappropriate content.

## Technical Constraints & Ambiguities
- The app should work smoothly on both iOS and Android.
- We want the app to be completely bug-free and scale infinitely without any slowdown.
- We expect to launch in the App Store within 4 weeks.

## Deliverables
- Source code in GitHub repository.
- TestFlight build for iOS and Internal Testing APK for Android.
- Basic admin dashboard for banned users.
